message.reasoning_content: Key bug: n_groups = n_cols // GROUP, so trailing group dropped when n_cols not multiple of group_size — those columns stay zero. Also rounding: floor(x/scale+0.5) vs round-half-away vs torch round (half-to-even); contract says "round" ambiguous. No clamping but q in [-127,127] so fine. absmax==0 gives scale=1, q=0 fine.
